title: Causal Uncertainty-Field Dynamics (CUFG): Gravitation from Overlapping Quantum Phase-Space Uncertainties at Speed c, Zero-Dark-Matter Cosmology, and the Subatomic Hierarchy
description: First-principles theoretical formulation, 9-manuscript trilogy/companion suite, interactive HTML5 explorers, and 40-suite numerical verification codebase exploring whether the Standard Model of physics can account for gravitational, cosmological, and subatomic benchmarks without bare spin-2 gravity (G_bare = 0), Dark Matter, Dark Energy (Lambda = 0), scalar inflatons, or Peccei-Quinn axions via an Effective Uncertainty Field propagating at the speed of light c. Features a nonlinear 10-component symmetric 4D Wigner phase-space covariance tensor action (Sigma_munu), 1st-order covariant FLRW stress-energy conservation (nabla_mu T^munu = 0) for the S^1 holonomy memory kernel, an Ab-Initio (Tiers 1-5) vs. Multi-Loop (Tiers 6-9) Monomial Selection-Rule Ablation, an 85-factor (F0-F81), 1,011-edge Causal Epistemological Dependency Graph (DAG), and 16 programmatic Referee Gates across 41 orders of magnitude.
notes: Software code (*.py) is licensed under the MIT License; theoretical manuscripts (*.md, latex/*.tex), figures (output/*.png), and repository-generated verification outputs (output/*.json, output/*.html) are licensed under CC-BY-4.0. Public third-party observational datasets in cufg/data/ belong to their original collaborations: SPARC (Lelli, McGaugh & Schombert 2016, AJ 152, 157, VizieR J/AJ/152/157) and X-COP (Ettori et al. 2019, A&A 621, A39; Eckert et al. 2019, A&A 621, A40; University of Geneva X-COP archive). Run `python -B run_all_tests.py` to execute all 40 benchmark suites and 16 Referee Gates.
